name: The Overseer

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Special Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların özel saldırı sırasındaki yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Sersemletmeye immündür ve herhangi bir özel saldırıdan hemen sonra otomatik bloklar. İsabetli saldırılı veya yetenek azaltıcı şampiyon en iyi cevap.
signatureAbility:
Retaliation
If an Opponent ability fails due to his personal immunity or reduced Ability Accuracy they take a burst of [622.07 - 4,067.24] Physical Damage and the Overseer gains one Gamma Power. This Damage scales with Base Attack Only. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.
Striking the Opponent while they are recovering from Heavy or Specials Attacks deal a burst of [1,309.09 - 10,167.97] Physical Damage. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı 🔮
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı (Hulks XL ile sinerji) 🧠
• Nötralize Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Spider-Man Supreme) 🗡️❌

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Immune to Nullify, Fateseal and Stagger effects.
An enhanced immune system provides full immunity to the Poisons of the Battlerealm.

abilitySections.title: Gamma Power
content: When the Opponent gains a Bar of Power gain an indefinite Gamma Power granting [1,525.2] Attack Rating and 17% Potency of his personal Debuffs from Specials. Max 6 Stacks.

abilitySections.title: Cosmic Mode
content: At 3 or more Stacks of Gamma Power, after launching a Special consumes all stacks and activates Cosmic Mode, lasting 3.33 second(s) per Gamma Power, but it is paused during Specials from the Overseer or the Opponent. Cosmic Mode lasts 50% longer for Defenders.

For each Gamma Power gained while in Cosmic Mode, instead gain a non-stacking Fury Buff granting [2,542] Attack Rating per Gamma Power used to enter the mode, with its total duration equalling its Cosmic Mode starting duration.
Light Attacks deal a Burst of [6,710.88] Physical Damage.

abilitySections.title: After Opponent Launches a Special - Special Concussion
content: Inflict an indefinite Special Concussion Debuff, reducing Ability Accuracy by 10% during Special attacks. Max 7.
Reducing a Combo of 3 or more to a lower amount removes one stack of Special Concussion.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Inflict a non-stacking Taunt Debuff for 10 seconds, reducing their Attack Rating by 20%. This ability goes on cooldown for 20 second(s) if activated.

abilitySections.title: After a Special - Cap's Shield
content: Gain an Auto-Block Passive, giving 100% chance to Auto-Block Basic Attacks when Struck twice, it lasts for 7 second(s) or until triggered.
The Overseer is Stun immune while Auto-Block is active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Inflict a Stun Debuff for 1.5 second(s).
Cosmic Mode: On activation gain a Regeneration Buff, recovering 7% of missing Health over 10 seconds. The Potency of this Buff is reduced by 10% for each Bleed Debuff on Overseer.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Inflicts a Disorient Debuff, reducing Defensive Ability Accuracy by 40% and Block Proficiency by 50% for 12 second(s). Ability Accuracy reduction scales with Gamma Power.
Cosmic Mode: Gain an Energize Buff, granting 25% increased Combat Power Rate for 12 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Physical Vulnerability Debuff, reducing Physical Resistance by [916.67] for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Retaliation
content: If an Opponent ability fails due to his personal immunity or reduced Ability Accuracy they take a burst of [622.07 - 4,067.24] Physical Damage and the Overseer gains one Gamma Power. This Damage scales with Base Attack Only. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.
Striking the Opponent while they are recovering from Heavy or Specials Attacks deal a burst of [1,309.09 - 10,167.97] Physical Damage. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.
